# Relaxonus

> Relaxonus sells one product: a manual six-roller neck and shoulder massager.
> It has no motor and no battery — the user controls the pressure by how hard they
> squeeze the two handles.

## Product

- **Name:** Relaxonus Neck & Shoulder Massager
- **Type:** Manual massage roller (not a powered or medical device)
- **Mechanism:** Two columns of three grooved rollers, each rotating 360°, reaching
  both sides of the neck at once. Pressure is applied by hand via two long handles.
- **Power:** None. No motor, battery, cable or app.
- **Dimensions:** 35 × 18 cm
- **Cleaning:** All six rollers detach, rinse under a tap, and click back on.
- **Options:** Blue ($34.99), Pink ($34.99), Blue + Pink Duo ($47.99)
- **Currency:** USD. Shipping is calculated at checkout.
- **Payment:** Apple Pay and Google Pay.

## What it is not

Relaxonus is a manual massage roller and a comfort accessory. It is not a medical
device and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any condition. No
claims are made about medical outcomes.

## Links

- Storefront: https://www.relaxonus.com
